_comment: Phase 33 session 5: Twe MCP server config. Paste the relevant snippet into your client's config (Claude Desktop: claude_desktop_config.json; Cursor: .cursor/mcp.json; etc.). The `command` should resolve to the twec binary on your PATH; on Windows use the `.exe` name explicitly if your shell needs it.

twe._description: Twe language tools — parse, verify, format, grammar export, stdlib manifest, structured-patch application. The `verify` tool returns JSON v2 with machine-applicable `fix` payloads that `apply_patch` consumes round-trip.
